title: Enumerate Scenarios Result
description: Return of the enumerate-scenarios-and-test-cases agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, and the scenarios in the shape of scenarios.schema.json

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: Only a question a human must answer before the work can be trusted, phrased as a question (such as what the task wants where it does not say), which sends G:scenarios to a human, or an empty string. Explanations of your choices go in notes, never here

notes.description: What you want to explain about your choices, in plain words, or an empty string. No gate reads it and it never stops the run

test_case_id.description: Unique identifier for the test case

final_checks.description: Optional. Acceptance criteria only a live, paid or manual run can show (a smoke run against a real model, a cost cap, a deploy, a human verdict, a file of live-run results), so no test can pass them. They run at the end and are never built as tests

description.description: What the check shows, in the task's words

command.description: The command a person runs for it, when the task or the repo names one

why.description: Why no test can show it, with its cost or time when known
